text: Obsession [Lat. obsessio , a besieging]: Ger. Besessenheit ; Fr. obsession ; Ital. ossessione , fissazione . (1) The explanation of marked neurotic and abnormal mental symptoms in a patient as due to the persevering efforts of an evil spirit to gain mastery over him. It differs from POSSESSION (q.v., as also DEMONOMANIA) in that it emphasizes the efforts of the demon from without, while in possession the demon is supposed actually to be resident in the body, and must accordingly be exorcized by appropriate agencies. (2) The persistent and irresistible presence of an idea or emotion; in this sense equivalent to an IMPERATIVE IDEA (q.v.). ( J.J. )
